verdict.rationale: Setting up a developer environment from one command is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Windows provisioning a full set of packages, tools, and runtimes in a single command. The PowerShell CLI probe and the WinUI 3/Windows App SDK quickstarts are general building blocks, not a one-command environment setup.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a full set of packages, tools, and runtimes ready to use with a single command
